meta: Over a hundred reviews, praise and complaints mixed together, and no time to read them all. Mark asks AI to group them, rank what to fix first, and draft replies.

muc.title: A hundred reviews
muc.text: Mark's shop has over a hundred reviews, praise and complaints mixed together, and he has no time to read them all to see what needs fixing.

muc.title: Paste them in, let AI group them
muc.text: Bit shows him: copy the reviews, hide customers' names, and paste them into AI. Ask it to sort them into praise and complaints, with how many times each point comes up.

muc.title: What to fix first
muc.text: Then ask AI to rank them: which complaint comes up most, and suggest three things to fix first. Mark finds over twenty customers saying the color looks different from the photo, exactly the lesson from part two.

muc.title: Answering bad reviews
muc.text: For bad reviews, ask AI to draft a public reply that thanks them for the feedback and says clearly what the shop has fixed. Future customers will feel reassured.

muc.title: Never use AI for fake reviews
muc.text: One thing you should never do: ask AI to write fake reviews. That's cheating customers, and the marketplace can shut down your shop.

muc.title: Three things to fix
muc.text: Copy your 50 latest reviews, ask AI for the three things customers complain about most, and fix one of them this week.
